# Service Catalogue

## [Consultancy Name] — Data, Automation & Intelligence Advisory

---

### Our Position

We are a specialist consultancy operating at the intersection of **data strategy, intelligent automation, and applied artificial intelligence**. Our primary technical home is the Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Cloud ecosystem, but our thinking is not bound by it. We design, audit, and implement solutions that leverage M365 where it is the right tool — and reach beyond it where open standards, multi-cloud, or specialist platforms deliver
